def: fond of words, i.e. talkative (argumentative, learned, "philological"); Philologus, a Christian

occurrences.text: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
